text:
Margo (eng-release): Heads up — planning a config-only deploy tonight 23:00 UTC. Scope: routing weight rebalancing for slow tails, default request_timeout 15s -> 12s, per-route batch_window_ms 50 -> 30, per-request batch_size cap 64 -> 48, and a soft rate floor change for prepaid customers. Canary-first, staged pinback policy.
Sam (infra): noted. what's the canary size and rollout cadence?
Margo (eng-release): start at 5% for 10min, if healthy bump to 20% for 15min, then 60%/100% as long as metrics stay green. plan to pin to current sha (v1.18.3) for 5m if we hit thresholds.
Alex (mlserving): clarify: this is config-only — no model binary changes, right?
Margo (eng-release): correct, config-only. safe to apply to routing layer + batching shim.
deploy-bot: /deploy config-only --name "split-phase-evening-pinback" --targets routing,batching,timeouts --canary 5% --step 20% --hold 10m
Priya (sre): monitoring checklist: set alert if error_rate > 1.0% sustained for 3m, or 95th_latency increases by >20% vs baseline for 5m. also watch p95 tail per-route.
Lina (oncall): I'll add a temporary dashboard and PagerDuty override window 23:00-01:30 UTC. thresholds: p95 > 400ms OR total 5xx rate > 0.8% -> pager.
Sam (infra): add route-side circuit-breaker: max_inflight_per_route 200 and rapid backoff for 429s. Also recommend enabling the soft fallback route to smaller-capacity pool.
Alex (mlserving): suggest we reduce per-request kv_cache TTL to 30s in the canary so we don't accidentally mask a regression in latency when we ramp.
Joel (product): heads-up — customers on dedicated plans in EU might see transient latency. we should call out in release notes and put a short banner on status.redwood.ai if we push to 100%.
Margo (eng-release): agreed. adding note to release notes: "Config-only: routing, batching, timeouts. Canary gating rules and emergency pinback to v1.18.3."
Priya (sre): rollback conditions proposal: auto-pin back to v1.18.3 if any of these for 5 continuous minutes: error_rate > 1% OR p95 > 450ms OR user-facing 429 spike > 0.5%. Manual rollback if other systemic signals appear.
Sam (infra): I'll instrument a short-lived metric for per-canary request_queue_length to help debug if we see queueing after batch_window change.
deploy-bot: canary 5% deployed at 3311112320 — monitoring hooks enabled. link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/deploys/3311112320
Lina (oncall): first 10m look: error_rate stable, p95 slightly up +6% but under alert. keeping watch.
Alex (mlserving): seeing a small increase in avg batch size on canary routes (expected with routing weight change). No sign of backlog.
Margo (eng-release): bumping to 20% now per plan. proceeding unless objections.
deploy-bot: ramp to 20% executed at 3311112480.
Priya (sre): 20% window 15m started — watching for sustained spikes. alerting if thresholds hit.
Lina (oncall): 15m check-in: metrics look within thresholds. p95 still +8% vs baseline but <450ms. no 5xx spike.
Joel (product): pushing short release note draft to #announcements for review, calling out EU dedicated customers.
Margo (eng-release): proceed to 60% in 10m if still green. final rollback knobs: automated pinback job and manual rollback playbook (link sent).
Sam (infra): note — after hitting 60% we should keep circuit-breaker stricter for additional 20m before relaxing.
deploy-bot: 60% ramp executed at 3311112700. final 100% scheduled after 20m hold if metrics pass.
Lina (oncall): holding 20m window. will escalate immediately if p95 > 450ms or >1% errors.
Margo (eng-release): thanks everyone. happy path: full rollout completes ~00:15 UTC and I'll mark the deploy done and publish release notes. if we hit any trigger we'll pin back to v1.18.3 and run the rollback checklist.
Priya (sre): copying rollback playbook link: https://playbooks.redwood.internal/rollback-config-pinback — follow steps 1-6 and notify #incidents.
Margo (eng-release): final: canary looks healthy after 22m at 60% — green to push to 100% now. proceeding.
deploy-bot: full rollout completed at 3311112750 — all steps succeeded, telemetry OK. automated post-deploy checks passed.
Lina (oncall): monitoring for next 2h. will post any anomalies.
Joel (product): thanks team — release note posted. will ping customers with notices for the EU dedicated group.
Margo (eng-release): closing thread — no rollback needed. will reopen if anything pops up. :tada:
